name: fire-v56
_note: 像素火 v55（B 档高密度）：32×54 格、FONT=10、SIZE_K=1.20、rowStep=11。验的是可在模拟器查清的部分：行数/行距/无写失败/有耗时汇总。真机渲染细节（缝与清晰度）只能真机看。

asserts.contains: TR boot fire_v56 densB cols=32 rows=54

asserts.source:
local n = 0
for i = 0, 53 do
  local c = query.control('FROW' .. i)
  assert(c ~= nil, 'FROW' .. i .. ' missing')
  assert(c.active == true, 'FROW' .. i .. ' inactive')
  n = n + 1
end
assert(n == 54, 'expected 54 rows, got ' .. n)
assert(query.logContains('rowStep=11'), 'rowStep must be 11')
assert(query.logContains('fails=0'), 'fails must be 0')
assert(not query.logContains('文本长度超出限制'), 'text length limit hit')

assert(query.logContains('TR density=v56_B'), 'no density summary')
assert(query.logContains('ms/update='), 'no ms measurement')
assert(query.logContains('rebuilt/update='), 'no rebuilt/update')
assert(query.logContains('fails=0'), 'fails must stay 0')
